items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: I was on that... I had heard that tune so much... I played on Paul Simon

ctx.x: You can’t forget that you were on that.

Well you know I remember, I had heard that tune so much and of course I knew it but you know in those days we were going from session to session and a guy came up for me to sign you know and I was like, “I’m sorry man, I played on Paul Simon but” and he says, “No, Lou, there’s your name there.” And it was like holy shit. It’s funny how some things you clearly remember and other things which you think should be a signal memory — a few years ago a guy called me up and asked me to do an interview about Jaco…

And he sent me some examples. I didn’t know that it was recorded. And it was with Mintzer and Randy were the soloists and that guy Othello Molineaux was playing steel drums and Jaco and I don’t remember who else was in the band. But when he sent it to me I could clearly hear myself in the horn section so, but man, I don’t have a shred of memory about this. And you would think that like Bergeron and Soloff were on it, Alex Foster was the other saxophone player. Nothing.
